name: African Skimmer
rangeDescription: Major rivers, lakes, and coasts of sub-saharan africa
description: Distinctive tern-like bird with long wings, a short tail, and a bizarre bill in which the upper mandible is shorter than the lower mandible. In slow flight, shows a very white underwing and a white stripe along the back of the upperwing.

name: White-breasted Robin
rangeDescription: Southwestern western australia (geraldton to esperance)
description: Small plump songbird found in heavy vegetation along creeks in southwestern Australia. White below, gray above, with darker gray wings.

name: Himalayan Griffon
rangeDescription: Himalayas from northwestern india to tibet and west-central china
description: A regal raptor of steppes, valleys, and mountainous regions, this large scavenger is fairly common throughout most of its range. Adult is sandy brown with a pale, featherless head.

name: Shelley's Rufous Sparrow
rangeDescription: Southeastern south sudan, southern and eastern ethiopia, northwestern somalia, northern uganda, and far western kenya
description: A typical sparrow with a striped back, a gray crown and nape, and a black bib. The rufous rump is conspicuous in flight.

name: Tufted Coquette
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela, trinidad, and the guianas to northern brazil
description: Tiny, ornately patterned hummingbird with a bold pale rump band. Exquisite adult male plumage features a bushy orange crest and long orange plumes tipped dark green, sweeping back from the cheeks over the shoulders, and set off by a white rump band and stout orange bill tipped black.

name: Creamy-bellied Antwren
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of peru (huánuco to cusco)
description: Small antwren found in the canopy of foothill forests of the eastern Andes in central Peru. Note the black cap, striped face, white wingbars, and lack of rufous in the wing.

name: Flores Crow
rangeDescription: Lowlands of flores (western lesser sundas)
description: An entirely black crow confined to the island of Flores. Found in small, vocal parties within forest in lowlands and hills.

name: Bronze-winged Courser
rangeDescription: Open woodland of sub-saharan africa
description: Large courser with dark brown upperparts and a white belly. In flight, shows a dark upperwing and a black-and-white underwing.

name: Gray-headed Elaenia
rangeDescription: Southeastern peru, northern bolivia, and adjacent brazil (undescribed subspecies, not true caniceps?); eastern and southern bolivia southward to northwestern argentina and eastward to paraguay, northeastern argentina, and south-central and eastern brazil
description: Small flycatcher found in humid forest in lowlands and lower mountain slopes. Male is gray with paler underparts and dark wings with white wingbars.

name: Taliabu Fantail
rangeDescription: Taliabu island (sula islands)
description: A lively little rufous songbird with a conspicuously long tail that is often cocked and fanned. Upperside is rufous except for darker brown band at end of tail.

name: Syrian Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Southeastern europe, transcaucasia, türkiye and iran to israel and jordan
description: Very similar to Great Spotted Woodpecker, differing mainly by the incomplete cheek band and the lack of black at the base of the bill. Males have a red nape, black in females.

name: Morotai White-eye
rangeDescription: Morotai (northern moluccas)
description: A tiny warbler-like songbird with a pale eye-ring, endemic to Morotai. Note black head, a broad white eye-ring, a pale forehead line, a pale patch between bill and eye, a gray back, and no yellow below.

name: Blue-winged Warbler
rangeDescription: Eastern usa; winters southeastern mexico to panama
description: Small, yellow warbler found in scrubby or cut-over habitats with some large trees, including field edges or powerline cuts. Yellow overall with black line through eye.

name: Biak Gerygone
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small bird of wooded habitats on Biak Island. Olive-brown back, gray head, pale yellow belly and broken white eye-ring.

name: Yelkouan Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds central and eastern mediterranean islands
description: Common locally in Mediterranean, where often seen from shore (as in Istanbul), and ranges regularly into Black Sea. Small, stiff-winged seabird often found in flocks, feeding with gulls and other species around fishing boats.

name: Choco Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid forest of northwestern colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: Small, rare woodpecker restricted to very wet lowland and foothill rainforest in western Colombia and far northwestern Ecuador. Both sexes have olive back and wings, extensive dark barring on underparts, and golden nape.

name: Short-billed Honeycreeper
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to venezuela, eastern peru, and western amazonian brazil
description: Tiny, colorful bird of forest canopy. Males are bright bluish-purple with black wings, mask, and throat; females are mostly green with a blue whisker stripe, buffy throat, and white streaking on flanks.

name: Green-backed Firecrown
rangeDescription: Central chile and argentina to tierra del fuego; juan fernández islands (far west of central chile)
description: The only hummingbird in most of southernmost South America. Fairly common to common in woodlands, forests, gardens, matorral, and flowering hedges and bushes in farmland of lowlands and foothills.

name: Black Jacobin
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil to uruguay and northeastern argentina
description: Large and aggressive hummingbird. Mostly black with white flanks.

name: Zenker's Honeyguide
rangeDescription: Southern cameroon and gabon to central african republic, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, and southwestern uganda
description: An infrequently encountered honeyguide of forests and forest edge. Overall olive-green to green in coloration, with upperparts darker than underparts and the brightest green in the wings.
